newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL -no provisions for price-fixing probe.
newsitem.headline: SGL -no provisions for price-fixing probe.

text.p: German graphite producer SGL Carbon said on Friday it saw no need to provide for possible claims resulting from an investigation into price-fixing conducted by cartel authorities in Europe and North America.
"We see no reason to build provisions. There has been no accusation," SGL Carbon management board chairman Robert Koehler told a news conference.
Koehler said that the document search by cartel authorities has been completed but that cartel watchdogs had made no formal accusations against SGL Carbon.
Koehler said the company had no further information on what the next step might be in the case.
He added that the company had retained lawyers and that they may well make provisions later in the year to pay for legal fees.
